name: spring-drop-in
title: Spring Drop In
description: Entrance motion built on a critically damped spring equation run in rAF: element falls from above with velocity-carrying overshoot, one bounce below rest position, then settles — parameterised by stiffness and damping, not keyframes.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- In View Trigger: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
